snippet.title: Evil Moon: Unspoken - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Demo available on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4861420/Evil_Moon_Unspoken/

Boomer Shooter Metroidvania. Nun with a gun. 

Because of the Malediction of the Moon, only devoted sisters with vows of silence can move freely in the city of Abbadox. So take up arms, Siléncia, and blast the your way through these cobbled and winding streets!
